name: Bossier City
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bossier City for 2026, and here is what he found: 18 family events, 11 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Santa's Wonderland at Bass Pro Shops) through January 3 (Reindeer Trails in Greenwood), with Winter Wonderland at Pierre Bossier Mall (November 27), Benton Christmas on the Square and the Christmas on Caddo Fireworks Festival (December 5), the Bass Pro Christmas Parade (December 12) and the Christmas Candy Trains in Belcher (December 22) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Bossier City

  • 18 Christmas events for kids in Bossier City and the Bossier and north Caddo parish towns around it, including Benton, Belcher, Gilliam, Plain Dealing, Oil City and Greenwood
  • 11 free events, including the Bass Pro Christmas Parade, Benton Christmas on the Square, the Christmas on Caddo Fireworks Festival and the Higginbotham-Bryson library Santa Visit
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Wonderland at Bass Pro Shops (November 26 to December 24), Visit with Santa at Bossier Parish Community College (December 5) and the Coca-Cola Santa Truck Caravan (December 6)
  • Parades and festivals: Benton Christmas on the Square (December 5) and the Bass Pro Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Lights and fireworks: Reindeer Trails Christmas Light Park (through January 3) and the Christmas on Caddo Fireworks Festival (December 5)
  • Crafts and story times: the Boardwalk faux stained glass workshop (December 6), gingerbread ornaments (December 8) and Christmas Story Time in Gilliam (December 8)
  • Season: November 26 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Bossier City families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Shreveport, just across the Red River, which covers the riverfront festival, Santa visits and shows.
